name: release
description: Changelog from the commits, version bump, release notes, your approval, then the tag.

stages.name: Changelog
stages.promptTemplate:
Release: {task}

Read the commits since the last tag (git log) and write a changelog grouped into features, fixes and breaking changes.

stages.name: Version bump
stages.promptTemplate:
Decide the next version from the changelog (breaking = major, feature = minor, fix = patch), update the version files, and explain the choice.

{input:changelog}

stages.name: Release notes
stages.promptTemplate:
Write release notes for users for: {task}

{input:changelog}

stages.name: Ask me
stages.promptTemplate:
State the version to release on the first line. Then summarize the changelog and the release notes, and what the tag will do. Wait for the user's approval.

{input:version}

stages.name: Tag
stages.promptTemplate: Create the git tag for the version approved in the step before you and report the commands you ran. Do not push unless the user asked for it.
